Data:S.henavek.json.Label: Henavek
Data:S.henavek.json.Desc: Kernewek Henavek; the oldest form of the language now called Cornish; or something even older.

Data:S.herbs.infusions.json.Label: Herbs & Infusions
Data:S.herbs.infusions.json.Desc: Pluck it, powder it, mix it, warm it, drink it. But not that one.

Data:S.hill.hollow.json.Label: Hill & Hollow
Data:S.hill.hollow.json.Desc: The ways of the hill-children and the gods-from-stone. Old paths, old secrets, the songs that still echo beneath the earth.

Data:S.horns.ivories.json.Label: Horns & Ivories
Data:S.horns.ivories.json.Desc: The Hunter, the Way, and their memories.

Data:S.hyksos.json.Label: Hyksos
Data:S.hyksos.json.Desc: The Shepherd-Kings brought this speech west from Canaan to use in their wards and snares. Had they never come to Egypt, they might never found a way to write it; given its addictive qualities, that might have been for the best.

Data:S.inks.containment.json.Label: Inks of Containment
Data:S.inks.containment.json.Desc: The inks in which the Histories are preserved.

Data:S.inks.power.json.Label: Inks of Power
Data:S.inks.power.json.Desc: The inks in which the Histories are written.

Data:S.inks.revelation.json.Label: Inks of Revelation
Data:S.inks.revelation.json.Desc: The inks in which the Histories are revealed.

Data:S.insects.nectars.json.Label: Insects & Nectars
Data:S.insects.nectars.json.Desc: The Hive, the Nest, and the Chrysalis are the three secret principalities of the lesser world. Two of those three know the temptations of sweetness.

Data:S.killasimi.json.Label: Killasimi
Data:S.killasimi.json.Desc: If there is speech in Nowhere; if there is a language used by the Dead; if the House of the Moon has a native tongue; then it must be Killasimi. If none of this is true, it is still not a language to be spoken in daylight. Each word breathes woe. Read it, as they say, and weep.

Data:S.leaves.thorns.json.Label: Leaves & Thorns
Data:S.leaves.thorns.json.Desc: There is no scent without sorrow.

Data:S.lockworks.clockworks.json.Label: Lockworks & Clockworks
Data:S.lockworks.clockworks.json.Desc: The little ways of little machines.

Data:S.maggephenemysteries.json.Label: Maggephene Mysteries
Data:S.maggephenemysteries.json.Desc: 'The greater plagues may not be cured, only bound. The very greatest of all may only be entreated… and it is death to do so improperly.'

Data:S.mandaic.json.Label: Deep Mandaic
Data:S.mandaic.json.Desc: The most secret script of the innermost rites of the deep sects of the deep desert. The birth-tongue, it is claimed, of the Mother of Ants herself.

Data:S.orchids.narcotics.json.Label: Orchids & Narcotics
Data:S.orchids.narcotics.json.Desc: There is no greed without beauty.

Data:S.ouranoscopy.json.Label: Ouranoscopy
Data:S.ouranoscopy.json.Desc: 'Consider the Star. Hath each Star, its Seven Names. Observe that these Names are Never Shared.' - Thomas Dewulf

Data:S.path.pilgrim.json.Label: Path & Pilgrim
Data:S.path.pilgrim.json.Desc: 'The traveller is always returning. One who does not is no traveller.' - Arun Peel

Data:S.pearl.tide.json.Label: Pearl & Tide
Data:S.pearl.tide.json.Desc: The depths of the sea, the waves upon the shore, and the memories of their withdrawal.

Data:S.pentiments.precursors.json.Label: Pentiments & Precursors
Data:S.pentiments.precursors.json.Desc: Feats and feits of forgotten things: the Carapace Cross, the line of Antaios, the world of a low red sun. 'Though much is taken, much abides.'

Data:S.preliminalmeter.json.Label: Preliminal Meter
Data:S.preliminalmeter.json.Desc: 'Nine modes, nine horizons': the subtle rhythms of words which open ways.

Data:S.purifications.exaltations.json.Label: Purifications & Exaltations
Data:S.purifications.exaltations.json.Desc: 'No-one ever truly wants to be truly changed. Azoth and refulgin are justly feared. But no-one who has been changed would choose to go back.' - George Collers

Data:S.pyroglyphics.json.Label: Pyroglyphics
Data:S.pyroglyphics.json.Desc: 'One script that all the world must read, even the blind, and it is written in flames.' Matters of fireworks and their kin - lights, colours, infernal detonations.

Data:S.quenchings.quellings.json.Label: Quenchings & Quellings
Data:S.quenchings.quellings.json.Desc: Arts which quench fires and bring solace to the troubled mind. 'A true adept is never troubled by fire, nor by fever, nor by restless spirit.' - Ambrose Westcott

Data:S.raggedcrossroads.json.Label: Ragged Crossroads
Data:S.raggedcrossroads.json.Desc: 'To understand why four paths were not taken.'

Data:S.ramsund.json.Label: Ramsund
Data:S.ramsund.json.Desc: This language has been called 'mantiq al-tair' and 'lenga aucel' and 'the speech of birds' and 'Ramsund' and 'the hazelnut tongue', but it's a language of secrets, and its true name may never be used. The aviform Hours use it at their Roost, or so the story goes.

Data:S.resurgences.emergences.json.Label: Resurgences & Emergences
Data:S.resurgences.emergences.json.Desc: Birth and death are only directions. Between the two we find a crossroads.

Data:S.rhyme.remembrance.json.Label: Rhyme & Remembrance
Data:S.rhyme.remembrance.json.Desc: To speak with the dead; to torment the living; to celebrate both.

Data:S.rites.theroots.json.Label: Rites of the Roots
Data:S.rites.theroots.json.Desc: The oldest Hours are the gods-from-blood, who rose from sacrifice. That blood was always spilt on the roots, and the rites of its spilling are still remembered.

Data:S.sabazine.json.Label: Sabazine
Data:S.sabazine.json.Desc: There is a History where Alexander defeated first the Great Knot of Sabazos, and then the King of Kings. There is another History where, instead, he learnt from them. How many more? If we curl our hands into the correct shapes, we may yet understand.

Data:S.sacralimiae.json.Label: Sacra Limiae
Data:S.sacralimiae.json.Desc: The rites of an order of immortals who have tried to remain apart. These rites touch on secrets of Hours of the Mansus - chiefly gods-who-were-flesh and gods-from-Light.

Data:S.sacrasolisinvicti.json.Label: Sacra Solis Invicti
Data:S.sacrasolisinvicti.json.Desc: The rites of the Church of the Unconquered Sun, and certain secrets of the gods-from-Light.

Data:S.sandstories.json.Label: Sand Stories
Data:S.sandstories.json.Desc: Of wandering tribes, watchful vagabonds, and winged devourers.

Data:S.seastories.json.Label: Sea Stories
Data:S.seastories.json.Desc: The sea has always been the widest road.

Data:S.serpents.venoms.json.Label: Serpents & Venoms
Data:S.serpents.venoms.json.Desc: These are the Mother's neglected children, and we prefer that they pass not through any door.

Data:S.sharps.json.Label: Sharps
Data:S.sharps.json.Desc: Knives, dangers, and things out of place.

Data:S.sickle.eclipse.json.Label: Sickle & Eclipse
Data:S.sickle.eclipse.json.Desc: Salt and silver; balance, necessity and rebuke.

Data:S.sights.sensations.json.Label: Sights & Sensations
Data:S.sights.sensations.json.Desc: To mix the rarest colours, a merciless detachment is required.

Data:S.skystories.json.Label: Sky Stories
Data:S.skystories.json.Desc: The nine winds gossip, and sometimes we can listen.
